quantity_reference.use: Accepted native precedent for ItemStructure.QTYPM=2 and local LRU stock two; this is a schema/configuration reference, not the behavioral parent.

manual_basis: Installed SIMLOX manual physical p425 says each candidate item or failure mode is investigated independently after system damage, and for QTYPM>1 the DamageItem.PROB value applies to each individual item, allowing several items to be damaged by one system damage. Physical pp426-427 say an individual item can be damaged only once and that REPF controls repair versus discard. Installed dictionary pins DamageItem keys and QTYPM.
source_delta: Accepted one-LRU H02.var01 source becomes two directly mounted interchangeable TEACH-LRU-01 physical instances with two local spares. A PROB0 control retains DAMP1 mission damage but no item consequence. Eight preselected seed1..8 children set the same DamageItem.PROB to 0.5; seeds2..8 also change Control.RSEED, and all arms change only descriptive text as specified in exact-diff. REPF1, explicit local DamageReplacement, ItemRepair, mission schedule and horizon36 remain fixed.

pre_run_hypotheses.control: The two-LRU PROB0 control should convert with zero errors and show no physical LRU damaged, no damage replacement stock draw and no attrition.
pre_run_hypotheses.cohort: The eight frozen PROB0.5 realizations may show zero, one or two distinct physical LRU consequences per BATTLE-HIT event. Native logs must identify individual physical instances; replacement and repair/stock consequences must reconcile per item and in the report. Observing distinct counts would support this configured per-item consequence path, not estimate a probability or prove statistical independence.
pre_run_hypotheses.alternatives: Conversion error, ambiguous physical identity, shortage/cancellation, repeated damage of the same individual before repair, no distinguishable outcomes or ledger mismatch is diagnostic only. Process exit alone is insufficient.

acceptance_gates: Independent pre-run static review of accepted H02 behavioral parent, G01 quantity reference, frozen exact diff, manual/dictionary basis and guarded runner
Fresh serial session-0 SSH native runs under Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue preserving GUI PID13340
Exact authored row-containing table roundtrips and zero converter errors with valid SXO/event log/report
Physical candidate/damaged LRU identities, mission damage and outcome, replacement and item-repair flow, 72 System/Stock bins and terminal inventory reconcile for every accepted run
SHA-256 sealed raw evidence and independent read-only post-run replay
limits: Eight preselected deterministic seeds do not estimate a 50 percent population rate or establish probabilistic independence. One item type with two identical directly mounted copies does not prove outcomes across distinct item types, nested structures, stations, shortages, GUI visual behavior or cross-engine parity.
